protocol.roots: All eight retained commands, all three identical retained responses per world, two original public-conditioned hypotheses.
protocol.samples: Four root RNG samples, first the original control seed; coupled across own commands.
protocol.next_turn_probe: Same public-only shortlist procedure, at most eight joint commands and three replies. One coupled RNG sample per continuation pair. No alternate action is selected from probe results.
protocol.phase_completion: Frozen V2 on each side public view for replacement/pivot phases, at most six; no live truth or independent-opponent fallback.
protocol.opportunity: Native direct damage to an opponent by the named attacker, with that attacker alive at completed-turn end. KO/trade and realized move order reported separately.
protocol.limits: Sampled opportunity, not win probability or proof of impossibility. Current-turn probes can miss multi-turn entry routes. These are already examined counterexamples, not held-out validation.

competing_plans.name: finish-gardevoir
competing_plans.abandon_when: Required attacking window or damage route is disproven, even if the resource is alive.
competing_plans.evidence_needed: Compare native attack/KO, blocker, speed-order and trade outcomes; living alone proves none of these.

competing_plans.name: remaining-material-exchange
requirements: a favorable remaining exchange or terminal win
competing_plans.evidence_needed: Measure actual knockouts, losses and remaining offensive resources without requiring the original centerpiece.

positions.speed_contract_scope: Diagnostic correction of double inversion on verified native signed-speed first-RNG frames. Uses this experiment phase-completion policy; frozen V2 replacements can differ from the old search backup. No scorer mutation, new weights, deployed action or full-game validation.
